mapper.sql: p.*, c.name AS customer_name, so.order_no AS sales_order_no, u.nickname AS manager_name, d.name AS dept_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_task t WHERE t.project_id = p.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_task s WHERE s.parent_id = t.id)) AS task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_task t WHERE t.project_id = p.id AND t.status = 'DONE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_task s WHERE s.parent_id = t.id)) AS done_task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_task t WHERE t.project_id = p.id AND t.status <> 'DONE' AND t.plan_end < #{today} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_task s WHERE s.parent_id = t.id)) AS overdue_task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_member m WHERE m.project_id = p.id) AS member_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ts.cost), 0) FROM pm_timesheet ts WHERE ts.project_id = p.id AND ts.status = 'APPROVED') AS labor_cost, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pc.amount), 0) FROM pm_cost pc WHERE pc.project_id = p.id AND pc.status = 'APPROVED') AS expense_cost, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) FROM pm_billing b WHERE b.project_id = p.id AND b.status = 'BILLED') AS billed_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fb.settled_amount), 0) FROM pm_billing b JOIN fin_bill fb ON fb.id = b.bill_id WHERE b.project_id = p.id) AS received_amount

FROM pm_project p LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = p.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.manager_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = p.dept_id LEFT JOIN scm_order so ON so.id = p.sales_order_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.status, p.customer_id, p.manager_id FROM pm_project p WHERE p.status IN ('PLANNING', 'APPROVING', 'ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_member m WHERE m.project_id = p.id AND m.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY p.code
